title: 3.2.B4 Build-Up — Tune Orbit Speeds
description: Adjust the frameCount multipliers so earth orbits slowly and moon orbits quickly — giving the system realistic relative speeds.

steps.title: Slow down earth's orbit
steps.instructions: Change earth's frameCount multiplier from 0.6 to 0.3 so it takes longer to circle the sun.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and review how frameCount drives animation speed.

steps.title: Speed up moon's orbit
steps.instructions: Change moon's frameCount multiplier from 2 to 3 so it laps earth more quickly.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and check the frameCount global section.

requirements.title: earth orbit speed adjusted
requirements.description: earth.position.x uses a multiplier different from 0.6 in the orbit math.

requirements.title: moon orbit speed adjusted
requirements.description: moon.position.x uses the anchor offset pattern.
